findings.finding: lanes.started_at is never written by RegisterLane or SetStatus in internal/ledger/ledger.go, so deriveToolRate in internal/serve/model.go:372-381 receives nil startedAt and applies the 1-second floor (toolRateFloorMinutes), computing toolCalls / (1/60) = toolCalls * 60 tools/min unconditionally. This is a pre-existing ledger lifecycle gap accurately anticipated and safely handled by deriveToolRate's fallback logic; it does not constitute a spec violation for lane-status-observability and is correctly tracked as follow-up GitHub issue #1.
findings.affects: internal/serve/model.go tool_rate precision and dashboard tool rate display until lanes.started_at is populated on lane start in internal/ledger.

findings.finding: TestServeStartsSweeperBesideHub in cmd/lucind-ai/cli_test.go:2131-2150 verifies sweeper initialization in serveDispatch by reading and parsing the source code text of cli.go (os.ReadFile('cli.go')) rather than asserting runtime goroutine dispatch or HTTP server lifecycle behavior. While sweeper mechanics are thoroughly tested in internal/serve/sweeper_test.go, this CLI wiring assertion relies on static string matching.
findings.affects: cmd/lucind-ai unit test fidelity for serve subcommand background worker startup.
